header: Billing questions engineers ask before signing
subheadline: Answers cover metering, overages and what happens when a batch dies halfway through. Anything not listed lives in the billing reference, and a written answer to a support ticket arrives the next business day.

question_items.question: What counts as a page?
question_items.answer: One side of a document sent to an endpoint. A 12-page PDF posted to the extraction endpoint counts as 12 pages, whether or not every page returns fields. Blank pages detected during splitting are not billed.

question_items.question: Are failed requests billed?
question_items.answer: No. Anything answered with a 4xx or 5xx status is excluded from metering, and pages from a batch that stops mid-run are credited back inside the same billing period without a support ticket.

question_items.question: What happens once the included pages run out?
question_items.answer: Extra pages bill at the plan rate: EUR 0.010 on Build, EUR 0.007 on Scale. The spend cap on the workspace stops processing at the ceiling you set instead of letting the invoice keep climbing.
